hints.title: Do the translation first
hints.body: Move the graph right by replacing x with x−3. Then subtract 5 from the whole expression to move it down. Sketch the starting and translated vertices to check these directions.
hints.recap: Horizontal movement changes what is inside the function; vertical movement changes its value.
hints.pitfall: Keep the square on the whole shifted bracket.
hints.pause: Write the translated equation without expanding.

recall.reminder: Horizontal movement changes what is inside the function; vertical movement changes its value.

hints.title: Reflect the whole expression
hints.body: Multiply the entire right-hand side of your translated equation by −1.
hints.recap: Reflection in the x-axis changes every height to its negative.
hints.pitfall: The constant term changes sign too.
hints.pause: Write the reflected equation, still keeping the square unexpanded.

recall.reminder: Reflection in the x-axis changes every height to its negative.

hints.title: Apply the horizontal stretch
hints.body: In your latest equation, replace every x with x2. Then expand and collect like terms.
hints.recap: A horizontal stretch by 2 doubles the x-coordinate of each point.
hints.pitfall: Replacing <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="inline"><mrow><mi>x</mi></mrow></math> by <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="inline"><mrow><mn>2</mn><mi>x</mi></mrow></math> would squeeze the graph horizontally.
hints.pause: Complete the substitution and expansion, then compare the coefficients with the options.

recall.reminder: A horizontal stretch by 2 doubles the x-coordinate of each point.

solution:
Apply the transformations in the given order. Translation gives y=4(x−3)2−5. Reflection in the x-axis then gives y=−4(x−3)2+5.

The final horizontal stretch replaces x by x2, yielding y=−4(x2−3)2+5. Expanding gives y=−4(x24−3x+9)+5=−x2+12x−31, option A.

As a check, the original vertex (0,0) becomes (3,−5), then (3,5), then (6,5). The final expression is −(x−6)2+5, with exactly that vertex and a downward opening.
knowledgePattern: Compose translation, reflection and horizontal stretch in order
